summary: Electra Battery Materials filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 13, 2026 press release disclosing a signed term sheet with commodities trader WMC Group AG for a five-year working-capital and commercial partnership. The arrangement finances cobalt feedstock purchases and battery-grade cobalt sales, adds logistics, market expertise, marketing support, and global network access, and WMC commits to invest in Electra upon definitive agreements. No stake, price per share, premium, or closing date disclosed. No advisor or board recommendation named. Risk-arb angle: definitive agreements, investment size, and regulatory clock remain watch items.
